pages.name: Login
pages.purpose: Email/password and Google OAuth login page. Firebase auth. Redirects to Portfolio Dashboard on success.
pages.layoutHint: Centered card on surface background. Brand logo above form. Asymmetric left margin for editorial feel. No universal dashboard layout — standalone auth page.
pages.emptyState: Not applicable — form is always visible.
pages.loadingState: Submit button shows spinner during auth request. Google OAuth button shows connecting state.
pages.errorState: Inline error message below form fields for invalid credentials. Toast for network errors.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Full-width card. Virtual keyboard does not obscure form. OAuth button prominently accessible below form.

pages.name: Signup
pages.purpose: User registration with username, email, full name, optional company name, and password. Firebase auth. Redirects to Company Setup on success.
pages.layoutHint: Centered card on surface background. Same visual treatment as Login for consistency. Brand logo above form.
pages.emptyState: Not applicable — form is always visible.
pages.loadingState: Submit button shows spinner during registration request.
pages.errorState: Inline field-level validation errors. Toast for server errors (email taken, network failure).
pages.mobileConsiderations: Single-column form. Full-width inputs. Submit button fixed at bottom on small screens.

pages.name: ForgotPassword
pages.purpose: Password recovery initiation. User enters email to receive a reset link via Firebase.
pages.layoutHint: Centered card, same visual language as Login/Signup. Single email input with submit button.
pages.emptyState: Not applicable — form is always visible.
pages.loadingState: Submit button shows spinner while sending reset email.
pages.errorState: Inline error for invalid email format. Toast for server/network errors.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Full-width card. Simple single-field form works well on all screen sizes.

pages.name: ResetPassword
pages.purpose: Password reset completion after email verification. User enters new password using token from email link.
pages.layoutHint: Centered card, same visual language as auth pages. New password + confirm password fields.
pages.emptyState: Not applicable — form is always visible.
pages.loadingState: Submit button shows spinner while resetting password.
pages.errorState: Error message for expired/invalid token. Inline validation for password mismatch.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Full-width card. Two password fields stack vertically.
validationRules: Confirm password must match new password
Reset token must be present in URL

pages.name: CompanySetup
pages.purpose: First-run onboarding wizard. User creates their first company with name, stage, industry, business model, and strategic goals. Routes to Portfolio Dashboard on completion.
pages.layoutHint: Centered single-column wizard with step indicator. No universal dashboard layout — standalone onboarding page. Progressive disclosure of fields.
pages.emptyState: All fields start empty — this is a creation form. Step indicator shows progress.
pages.loadingState: Submit button shows spinner during company creation API call.
pages.errorState: Inline field-level validation errors. Toast notification on server error.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Single-column layout works natively on mobile. Inputs auto-expand. Submit button fixed at bottom on small screens.
validationRules: Company name is required and non-empty
Goals should be provided (at least one sentence)

events.name: company_created
events.trigger: User submits wizard and server returns success

pages.name: PortfolioDashboard
pages.purpose: All companies owned by the user displayed as cards. Portfolio-wide summary header. Add new company action. Entry point to per-company workspaces.
pages.layoutHint: No universal dashboard layout — portfolio-level page. Header with portfolio summary. Grid of company cards below. Add company button in header or as empty-state CTA.
pages.emptyState: No companies yet. Large CTA: 'Create your first company' with illustration. Routes to Company Setup.
pages.loadingState: Skeleton cards in grid layout. Portfolio summary shows shimmer placeholders.
pages.errorState: Toast notification for failed data fetch. Retry button in card area.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Company cards stack vertically in single column. Add company button floats at bottom.

pages.name: CommandCenter
pages.purpose: Founder dashboard for selected company. Universal dashboard layout with KPI cards, active workflows, recent tasks, alerts in workspace. Floating AI control panel with stub data. Right rail AI chat stub.
pages.layoutHint: Universal dashboard layout: Header (glassmorphism, org context switcher, search, notifications, account), Floating AI Control Panel (sticky top-center, collapsed KPI chips + alerts + next action), Left Rail (Home, Tasks, Workflows, Org, Settings), Workspace (KPI cards grid, active workflows list, recent tasks, alerts), Right Rail (AI chat stub + agent status).
pages.emptyState: New company state. KPI cards show zero values. Workspace shows onboarding prompts: 'Add your first task', 'Create a workflow', 'Set up your org chart'.
pages.loadingState: Skeleton cards for KPIs. Shimmer placeholders for workflow and task lists. Floating AI panel shows loading dots.
pages.errorState: Individual sections show retry buttons on failure. Toast notification for API errors.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Left rail collapses to hamburger menu. Right rail becomes a floating chat button. KPI cards scroll horizontally. Floating AI panel collapses to minimal chip.

events.name: quick_action_clicked
events.trigger: User clicks a quick action button

pages.name: OrgChart
pages.purpose: Visual organizational chart for the company. Departments and roles displayed as tree nodes. Each role shows title, department, assigned human, and AI agent slot (placeholder). Editable — add/remove departments and roles. Generates default structure on first load based on company stage.
pages.layoutHint: Universal dashboard layout. Workspace contains the org tree visualization — horizontal tree flowing left to right or top to bottom. Role detail panel slides in from right on node click. Glassmorphism cards for each node.
pages.emptyState: No departments yet. System offers to generate a default org structure based on company stage and business model. CTA: 'Generate recommended structure' or 'Start from scratch'.
pages.loadingState: Skeleton tree nodes with shimmer animation. Detail panel shows loading state.
pages.errorState: Toast for failed CRUD operations. Retry on tree load failure.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Tree view scrolls horizontally. Nodes are tappable. Detail panel becomes a bottom sheet instead of side panel.
validationRules: Department name is required and non-empty
Role must belong to a department

pages.name: AgentChat
pages.purpose: Full-page AI executive assistant interface (DEX). Persistent conversation history per company. Accepts user messages and returns stub responses in v1. Primary human-AI interaction surface. Shows conversation thread, agent status indicator, and suggested actions panel.
pages.layoutHint: Universal dashboard layout. Workspace is the full-width conversation thread. Right rail is hidden (chat IS the workspace on this page). Suggested actions panel floats above the chat input.
pages.emptyState: No conversation yet. DEX introduces itself: 'I'm DEX, your AI executive assistant. Ask me anything about your company.' Shows 3-4 suggested starter prompts.
pages.loadingState: Typing indicator (animated dots) while waiting for AI response. Message history shows skeleton bubbles on initial load.
pages.errorState: Failed message shows retry button inline. Toast for network errors.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Full-screen chat view. Input bar fixed at bottom. Suggested actions collapse into a horizontal scrollable chip row.
validationRules: Message content is required and non-empty

pages.name: TaskBoard
pages.purpose: Kanban-style task management board with columns: Backlog, In Progress, In Review, Done. Tasks are draggable between columns. Create, edit, move, delete tasks. Filter by assignee, priority, status. DEX (AI) is available as an assignee option.
pages.layoutHint: Universal dashboard layout. Workspace contains horizontal scrollable kanban board with 4 columns. Filter bar above the board. Create task button in header or as floating action.
pages.emptyState: Empty board with column headers visible. CTA in first column: 'Create your first task'. Suggested task templates based on company stage.
pages.loadingState: Skeleton task cards in each column. Column headers visible immediately.
pages.errorState: Toast for failed task operations (create, move, delete). Optimistic updates with rollback on failure.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Columns scroll horizontally. Task cards are full-width within column. Create task button floats at bottom-right. Edit task opens as bottom sheet.
validationRules: Priority must be one of: low, medium, high, critical
Status must be one of: backlog, in_progress, in_review, done
Due date must be in the future when set

events.name: task_moved
events.trigger: User drags task to new column

pages.name: Workflows
pages.purpose: List and manage SOPs/workflows for the company. Each workflow has steps (human/AI/tool). Create, edit, run workflows step by step. Running a workflow tracks progress through steps.
pages.layoutHint: Universal dashboard layout. Workspace shows workflow list as cards. Clicking a workflow opens the runner view showing step-by-step progress. Create workflow button in header.
pages.emptyState: No workflows yet. CTA: 'Create your first workflow'. Suggested workflow templates based on company stage (e.g., Client Onboarding, Content Publishing, Sales Pipeline).
pages.loadingState: Skeleton workflow cards. Runner view shows step shimmer placeholders.
pages.errorState: Toast for failed operations. Step completion errors show inline retry.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Workflow cards stack vertically. Runner view is full-screen with step progress bar at top. Steps scroll vertically.
validationRules: Status must be one of: draft, active, deprecated
Step type must be one of: human, ai, tool
Steps must have sequential order values

events.name: workflow_completed
events.trigger: All steps in workflow marked done

pages.name: Settings
pages.purpose: User profile settings, company settings for active company, notification preferences, and agent autonomy levels (UI only in v1). Tabbed interface.
pages.layoutHint: Universal dashboard layout. Workspace contains tabbed settings panel. Tabs: Profile, Company, Notifications, AI Autonomy. Each tab has a form with save button.
pages.emptyState: Profile tab shows current user data pre-filled. Company tab shows active company data. Notifications tab shows default preferences.
pages.loadingState: Form fields show shimmer placeholders while loading user/company data.
pages.errorState: Inline validation errors on form fields. Toast for save failures with retry.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Tabs become a vertical list or accordion on mobile. Forms are single-column. Save button fixed at bottom.
validationRules: Autonomy level must be one of: observe, recommend, assist, execute

pages.name: NotFound
pages.purpose: 404 not found handler. Displays a friendly error when users navigate to a route that does not exist.
pages.layoutHint: Centered single-column layout with illustration, message, and action button stacked vertically. No universal dashboard layout — standalone error page.
pages.emptyState: Not applicable — content is always static.
pages.loadingState: Not applicable — no data to load.
pages.errorState: Not applicable — this page IS the error state.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Full-width centered layout. Illustration scales down on small screens. Button remains full-width and tappable.

events.name: page_viewed
events.trigger: User lands on a non-existent route

events.name: back_to_home_clicked
events.trigger: User clicks back to home button

sharedComponents.name: UniversalLayout
sharedComponents.purpose: Base layout wrapper for all authenticated pages. Renders Header, LeftRail, Workspace slot, RightRail, and FloatingAIPanel. Applies glassmorphism design system.

sharedComponents.name: Header
sharedComponents.purpose: Glassmorphism top navigation bar with organization/portfolio context switcher, global navigation, search (UI only in v1), notifications bell, and account menu.

sharedComponents.name: LeftRail
sharedComponents.purpose: Navigation sidebar with links to Home (Command Center), Tasks, Workflows, Org Chart, and Settings. Surface-container-low background, no dividers between items. Highlights active item.

sharedComponents.name: RightRail
sharedComponents.purpose: AI interaction surface on the right side. Glassmorphism panel containing a chat thread with DEX (stub responses in v1), agent status indicator, and execution status.

sharedComponents.name: FloatingAIPanel
sharedComponents.purpose: Sticky floating panel at top-center of workspace. Collapsed state shows KPI chips, alert count, and next-best action. Expanded state shows deeper insights, workflow context, AI recommendations. Glassmorphism card with primary gradient accent border. Stub data in v1.

sharedComponents.name: AgentChatStub
sharedComponents.purpose: Reusable chat interface component for DEX interactions. Accepts user messages and returns stub responses. Used in RightRail and AgentChat page. Designed for real AI swap — replace the response function, keep the UI.
